translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: Corintosha keranguemulachi Pablo' pilla kiika main

content: Tsandenna inu Dios tsandikaañu kerajtunu palaachi bain, naa anjeela' palaachi bain patimu ju'ba, veelanuya estyatyushu juntsaa, ti jeru dapeeba ju' deviiñu pakamu jun tsaayu, ne kanbana depakaañu na'baasa fidyatin tsandimu jun tsaayu.

Tsenmin naa iya Diosa' mitya pamu ju' bain, naa Dios tyee kiikenuu juñuba tsaatala de-aseetaju ju' bain, naa ti bain nara demii ju' bain, tsenmin Diosyaa tiba uwain tsanguenu tsuve tenna ju', naa kuyi juu bain vee mujtu mashilla' ere' chujtinu ma juju' bain, munuba estyatyu jushu juntsaa, tiba juñu jutyuyu.
Tsenmin iya ti ta'ba pure chachillanu tsaa develeke' bain, naa dajkatawachi tenñu ura in buluren veela' mitya tyeeba inu ti', ne kayakutike' bain,
munuba estyatyu jushu juntsaa, tsangui'ñuba ne uraanu juve.
Estyan chumu chachiya tinuba jei kidandai paijtyu juve, mika ura juve, kishtyatyu juve, veelanu ti' mityaba depullaayu tyatyu juve, dajtyatyu juve,
munuba balenguumu juve, yachin uraanuu kityu juve, ajaavin chutyu juve, naa yanu firu' kemuwa deeñu bain, tsaatala mandengaken chutyu chachi juve,
firu' juunutalaya sundyatyu juve, tsaaren tiba uraanuu juutalaya sundyave'mu juve.

Tsa' mitya estyan chumu chachi jushu juntsaa, ti firu' dekiñuba tsa dekemu kuretyu juve, ti bain uwain tsanguenu detsuve tyamu juve, tiba uwain naa naa-inu tsuve tyañuba tsainu tsuve tya' keenamu juve, tsenmin naamika taajuñuba paviyaken chutyu juve.

Estyanutsumuya naa-uwanuba de-i' piyan jutyuve. Tsaaren Diosa' mitya papatintsunu palaayaa mandinbu tsandintsun jutyu tiyanu tsuve, tsenmin Dios tsandikaañu mera' kerajtunu palaachi papatimula bain tsandintsun jutyu tiyanu detsuve, tsenmin Dios tyee kenu juñuba juntsa keewarajtu junutala bain keemijainuu jutyu tiyanu detsuve.
Matyu entsa tinbutala lala Diosa' mitya tyeeba demijañu bain, naa Diosa' mitya tiba pandetsuñu bain, juntsalaya kumuinchi dejuu jutyuve,
tsaaren bene tiba de-ura' juu jumu janmalaya, challa Espíritu Santo tsanguikaañu ke' keewara jumulaya de-inu tsuve, juntsalaya mika urandene jutyu' mitya.
Kaspele iya añuñutuya kailla tyee pan chumu deeñu bain, tyee pensanguen chumu deeñu bain, naake aseetanguemu deeñu bain tsaawaayu, tsaaren derukumee kailla naaken chumu deeñuba tsa mantyu tiyaiyu.

Challaya tinaaba kere' lala' kajurunu jumululungue kataakeñuu kemu deeyu Dioschi tiba mijakare' keewara jumulanu; tsaaren bene ma malu Diosnu kaju'tala entsangue katanu detsuyu. Challaya Diosnu ma tsandaa keraayu, tsaaren bene Dios inu naaju kerañuba i bain yanu entsai keemijanu tsuyu.

Chaiba de-ityumujchi tsanamulaya pema dejuve: Diosnu keenguenu pensa bain, Diosya uwain tsanguenu tsuve tya' keenanu pensa bain, tsenmin veta' veta' estyanutsumu bain. Tsaaren entsalanu veta' veta' estyanutsumaa kayu baleve.

footnotes.text: 13.3 Mantsa tinbu kiikatalaya dajkatawachi tenñu ura in buluren veela' mitya tyeeba inu ti', ne kayakutike' bain tityumujchi, entsa pillave: ura in bulu bain jupekutike'ba.
